name: Provisioners
description: Declarative, idempotent bootstrapping for the services your stack depends on. One small Go binary per service — describe what should exist, run it as an init container, and your app starts against a ready environment.

steps.title: Describe
steps.body: Declare the resources that should exist in a YAML file. Secrets come in through ${VAR} expansion.

steps.title: Provision
steps.body: Run the provisioner as an init container or Kubernetes Job. It waits for the service, then creates or updates.

steps.title: Start
steps.body: Your application starts once provisioning has completed — against an environment that is guaranteed to be ready.

compose.code:
services:
  postgres-provisioner:
    image: ghcr.io/datarocks-ag/postgres-provisioner:{{version:postgres-provisioner}}
    depends_on: [postgres]
    environment:
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      PGHELPER_CONFIG_PATH: /config.yaml
    volumes: ["./provision/postgres.yaml:/config.yaml:ro"]

  keycloak-provisioner:
    image: ghcr.io/datarocks-ag/keycloak-provisioner:{{version:keycloak-provisioner}}
    depends_on: [keycloak]
    environment:
      KEYCLOAK_URL: http://keycloak:8080
      KEYCLOAK_CONFIG_PATH: /config.yaml
    volumes: ["./provision/keycloak.yaml:/config.yaml:ro"]

  app:
    depends_on:
      postgres-provisioner:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      keycloak-provisioner:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
